text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she missed out on victory in the 
Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, Narita Taishin's powerful 
run fueled by her explosive burst 
captivated the entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is said that in the stands, a small, 
red-haired girl was moved to tears by that 
run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next stage is the "Japanese Derby"— In 
order to rebuild and train herself anew, 
Narita Taishin departed the venue.
